decision: How should Home and Workbooks > Production organize the team's daily jobs (new customers, workbook production, new signups, marking)?
primary_axis: organizing model of Home and Production: by job (task list), by metric (overview), or by pipeline (board)
decided_before_round: Sidebar with folders: Home; Families (Families, Tests, Feedback); Workbooks (Production, Plans and delivery, Marking); Maya (Calls); Marketing (Flyers, Emails); Quality (Templates, Skill map, AI reviews); Team tools (Parent app preview, Export)
Maya board removed; Maya chat access moves onto each family's page; Ads page later
One 'Show test families' switch, off by default, for every page
Plain copy: no ticket numbers, no developer notes, raw data in a closed section
invariants: shared.css and shared.js: the same sidebar, folders, badges, test switch, sample data and routing
warm look tokens from src/ds/styles/warm.css (Geist, Geist Mono labels, orange square marker, soft cards, 6-8 px corners)
evidence: Savar can say in 5 seconds: who became a customer, which workbook needs him, how many signups came in, and how many answers wait for marking; and he can act on each in one click.

options.bet: Task list: Home is 'Today', the four jobs in Savar's order, each with the rows that need action and the action button
options.benefit: Fastest from opening the page to acting
options.risk: On a quiet day the page looks empty; numbers hide below

options.bet: Overview: Home is four large graphic modules (customers, production, signups, marking), each a chart plus its top items
options.benefit: Health of the business at a glance; most graphic
options.risk: Charts with small numbers (2 customers) can look thin or noisy

options.bet: Pipeline: Home is a journey board of families by stage; Production is a board of books by stage
options.benefit: Each family's and book's place is visible in one picture
options.cost: Wide boards need horizontal scroll on small screens
options.risk: Does not scale past about 30 families per column

status: selected: B with A actions and C family board (D-315)
